bio: Escape the rush of the working week with this soul-soothing experience in rural North Devon. Indulge in a traditional afternoon tea for two with tea or coffee. Leave your troubles at the door; this charming 18th century country manor is guaranteed to lift your mood. Set across 20 green acres including ancient woodland, this North Devon bolthole is the perfect place to enjoy a quintessentially British treat. Along with your loved one, take a seat and tuck into a delectable traditional afternoon tea. Make the most of the freshly baked scones with clotted cream and homemade fruit preserves. Indulge with intricate pastries made by the talented in-house pastry team and fill up on dainty sandwiches. Finish it all off with your choice of ground coffee or tea. This luxurious treat is the whole package, offering beautiful views, comfortable surroundings and top-notch food.
